content: The second row shows the performance of our basic paragraph-level model which predicts both implicit and explicit discourse relations in a paragraph. Compared to the variant system (the first row), the basic model further improved the classification performance on the first three implicit relations. Especially on the contingency relation, the classification performance was improved by another 1.42 percents. Moreover, the basic model yields good performance for recognizing explicit discourse relations as well, which is comparable with previous best result (92.05% macro F1-score and 93.09% accuracy as reported in BIBREF11 ).
